author: The Slow Mo Guys
description:
Gav and Dan demonstrate where not to place a Phantom camera while trying to skewer multiple swinging pendulums with a single crossbow bolt. Could this have been completed in 1/10th the time with an expert? Yes, but where's the fun in that?
Check out our new Patreon! - https://www.patreon.com/theslowmoguys
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/theslowmoguys
Tik Tok - https://www.tiktok.com/@theslowmoguys
Filmed with the very happy to be alive Phantom VEO 4K at 1000fps 
Music - Heaven and Hell by Jeremy Blake
title: Crossbow vs Triple Pendulum in Slow Motion - The Slow Mo Guys
